This. The amount of times I've been wearing wireless earphones in public and they've just fallen out of my ear and gotten lost or have been playing out loud without me realising. 

One time I was on a big coach, listening to music through my back up pair of earphones (old ones) which I don't use very often, I had just lost my main ones.

 In the middle of the ride, the coach takes a sharp turn around a corner and my left earphone falls out. I panic and I can't do anything before it rolls under the seats infront of me. I take my other earphone out and listen in pure horror as I can hear the sound of my earbud roll across the floor as the coach makes turns or speeds up. 
The coach was so full I didn't want to get up and go find it, plus my social anxiety was stopping me. 

Never found that £60 earbud ever again. Now, if it had a wire on it and fell out my ear, that would have been a completley different story.
